name: Rahat Sayyed
jobTitle: Software Engineer, AI Agent Systems and TypeScript
summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building TypeScript systems around AI agents, MCP tool access, and model I/O. At Copods I built the governance layer that controls how agents reach MCP tools and how model traffic is audited, cutting policy misconfiguration issues by ~50%. I also connect evolving model capabilities to internal tools across frontend, backend, and AI teams, and I measure outcomes with dashboards and event tracing.

experience.title: Software Engineer
description: Led the architecture and implementation of a modular, policy-driven governance layer centralizing MCP access control and model I/O auditing, enabling consistent enforcement across agent workflows and reducing policy misconfiguration issues by ~50%.
Designed multi-policy schemas and contract-driven TypeScript APIs, reducing integration-related regressions by 70% as AI interfaces evolved.
Coordinated frontend, backend, and AI teams to integrate 3+ evolving model capabilities with governance constraints, keeping policy enforcement consistent as new tools and agents were introduced.

Built a unified violations ingestion pipeline across LLM, MCP and RAG flows, standardizing observability and cutting incident investigation time by approximately 40% through centralized event tracing.
Developed D3-based interactive risk analytics dashboards to distinguish LLM vs. tool exposure patterns, accelerating policy debugging and strengthening audit traceability across 12+ policies.
Directed a system-wide refactor of React state management, eliminating 9+ redundant API calls and reducing initial load time by 11 seconds.
Optimized the Docker-based frontend build pipeline on AWS EC2 through dependency installation restructuring and layer caching, reducing development build times by ~10 minutes.

experience.title: Web 3.0 Developer
description: Built secure Next.js frontend integrations using Lucid.js and Mesh.js, connecting 8+ Cardano smart contracts to a Haskell based backend and REST services.
Designed and deployed Aiken-based smart contracts for a carbon credit marketplace, refactoring validation logic to reduce transaction failures by 80%.
Performed smart contract reviews and testing to identify edge cases and failure scenarios, improving reliability before mainnet deployment and identifying 8 vulnerabilities.
